annotations.comment: identifiers/component-map.yaml entry 'mbedtls': added cpe:2.3:a:trustedfirmware:mbed_tls:4.1.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*; added cpe:2.3:a:mbed-tls:mbedtls:4.1.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*. Rationale: NVD files Mbed TLS vulnerabilities under three different CPE vendor:product pairs. The module's module.yml declares only arm:mbed_tls, so a CPE-based scanner would silently miss every CVE filed under the other two names. annotations.comment: identifiers/component-map.yaml entry 'picolibc': component added, version 1.8.10; supplier Organization: picolibc project; added pkg:github/picolibc/picolibc@1.8.10. Rationale: west spdx lists the picolibc headers only inside one unversioned "sdk" package and does not list libc.a at all, although its code is in the firmware. Version from __PICOLIBC_VERSION__ in the picolibc.h whose hash is pinned here. No CPE: none in the grype DB baseline. Its ancestor newlib has CVEs under newlib_project:newlib; that is a different product and is NOT mapped (needs a human decision). Evidence: picolibc.h sha256 in sdk.spdx = hash above, which says 1.8.10; libc.a in the linker map (sbom/summary.json); upstream tag 1.8.10 exists (git ls-remote, 2026-10-15). Added by Claude (AI assistant) on 2026-10-15; NOT reviewed by a person yet.

annotations.comment: identifiers/component-map.yaml entry 'gcc': component added, version 14.3.0; supplier Organization: GNU Project; added cpe:2.3:a:gnu:gcc:14.3.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*. Rationale: libgcc.a is statically linked but appears nowhere in the raw SBOM. NVD tracks GCC as gnu:gcc; most GCC CVEs concern the compiler, not libgcc, so expect findings that need a VEX decision (Phase 6) rather than a silent omission. Evidence: libgcc.a in the linker map (sbom/summary.json); headers under .../14.3.0/include in sdk.spdx; grype DB baseline: gnu:gcc 14 CVEs. Added by Claude (AI assistant) on 2026-10-15; NOT reviewed by a person yet.

annotations.comment: identifiers/component-map.yaml entry 'cjson': component added, version 1.7.17; supplier Organization: Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors; added cpe:2.3:a:cjson_project:cjson:1.7.17:*:*:*:*:*:*:*; added cpe:2.3:a:davegamble:cjson:1.7.17:*:*:*:*:*:*:*; added pkg:github/davegamble/cjson@v1.7.17. Rationale: west spdx lists vendored files as application sources, so no scanner can see a library here. NVD uses two vendor names for cJSON (cjson_project for recent CVEs, davegamble for older ones); both are added. The PURL uses the upstream repository and tag, which is also how OSV records name it. Evidence: cJSON.h defines CJSON_VERSION 1.7.17 and is byte-identical to the upstream tag; cJSON.c is the tag plus the patch in app/lib/cjson/patches (both hashes pinned here). grype DB baseline: cjson_project:cjson CVE-2023-53154, CVE-2024-31755; davegamble:cjson older CVEs (<= 1.7.6). Added by Claude (AI assistant) on 2026-10-15; NOT reviewed by a person yet.
